description: This short circular walk visits Lough Melvin on the border between County Leitrim and County Fermanagh. There's a parking area just west of the village of Garrison where you can start your walk. From here you can follow footpaths along the south eastern corner of the lake. It's a lovely spot with a pretty little park and benches where you can sit and enjoy a wonderful view across the water.You can continue your walk by heading into Garrison along the Roogagh River. If you head south you could also pick up theFowley's Falls and Glenaniff River Walk.
